title: ACTIVE RELOAD STACKS
why: his order 10-27: make the active reload stack but it gets harder each time; each active reload in a row adds 10 percent to the bonus up to x1.55 and narrows the next sweet spot by a quarter, a miss or a reload left to run out starts over
now: active reload stacks, the sweet spot shrinks each time
